~First Things First~

In battles between Blazers,
called Blazer Battles...#
you stick MYSTICKERs on your arms
to power up and attack.
The goal is to bring your
opponent's HP to 0.#

~The Speed Gauge~

This is the Speed Gauge. It's shown
at the top right of the bottom screen.

The Speed Gauge shows icons
for every character,
friend and foe alike.#
As time passes, these icons
move to the right
along the Speed Gauge.

When an icon reaches the right
end of the gauge, it's that
character's turn to take an
"ACTION".#
In other words, fast characters'
icons move faster, so their
turns come around more
often.

Are we really gonna be okay?

Blazers this, Guardians that...

us again, like back in Ward {g:9945}...

Relax.
I'm not losing to anybody.

And I'll blow through this

...Right. If Shiro says it's
okay, then it's okay!

Ahh, now that I'm relieved,
I'm getting kinda hungry.

Hmph... Let me guess.
You're craving curry again?

Bingo~! That's my Shiro.
You know me so well!

We go way back.
I couldn't NOT know...
Ahahaha!

Shirou! I've been looking
for you!
Wh-what's with you all of a sudden!?

So that girl really IS
your girlfriend, huh?

Girlfriend?
What girl...?

Oh, don't play dumb~.
I mean Tamaki, obviously!
Oh, don't play dumb~.

Sh-she is not! She's just
my childhood friend...

We've been stuck with each
other since we were little.

Your first mission at last.
Don't go charging in alone, okay?

Yeah, yeah, I know.
Tama, you just wait here.

Hey, I wonder what the
other Blazers are like?

...Who knows. Stick around
here and we'll meet 'em.

If you ask me, they're all
super huge and buff!
Why... buff?

Well, they fight people who
abuse MYSTICKERs, right?

You'd never last without
a ton of stamina.

I bet as you keep up your
Blazer training, Shirou...

You'll get all big and
super-mega buff!
Nope. Not happening. Relax...

Like the word "branch" says,
there's also a headquarters.

Tokyo Ward {g:994E} has several
Guardian branches, and...

We carry out missions sent
from HQ,

and keep the people of
Tokyo safe.

Hey, old man. Is this Yaiba
guy really that strong?

Hm? Well... he's definitely
stronger than you are now.
Tch...

Mind you, he was a handful too
when he first became a Blazer.

Just like you, he wanted
to prove himself...

He even went off on a
mission alone once.
...Seriously?

Maybe he sees his old
self in you.

And maybe that's exactly
what ticks him off.

Anyway, that's how it is.
So hang in there, kid.

Huh? You've been staring at
me. You want something?

One question. Did Kuroki
really scout you?

Give it a rest...
I told you he did.

Why would Kuroki bring a guy
like this into the Guardians?
...I don't get it at all.
H-hey... hold on a sec!

He says his piece, then
just walks off.

Just watch. I'll clear a
mission all by myself.
Yaiba puppet removed after this.

Man...
it's hot today, huh?

Feels normal to me.

where's that creepy critter?
I haven't seen it around...

...Really? Now that you say it,
I haven't seen it either.

Knowing Pettan, it's stuck
to something somewhere!
Well... yeah, probably.

branch, is a charming town.

Lots of folks in Ward {g:994D} still
live the old-fashioned way.

Sure, MYSTICKERs have made
life a lot easier, but...

Seeing the streets at sunset
reminds me of something...

something important I'd
nearly forgotten, y'know~.

Getting all poetic there?

take me on the mission?

don't slow me down.

I'll do your share too!
Tama... something wrong?

go with you, Shiro.

you're not a Blazer...

be useful somehow too-

wait here quietly.

I'll wrap up the mission and
be right back.

Kuroki...?

happened to have a map...

and handed it to whoever
happened to be in front of me...

the missions going?
